title: Communications Manager, VoteUSA
description:
Volunteer: Communications Manager, VoteUSA
Remote (U.S.‑based) • Volunteer • Communications Leadership • Civic Engagement
Fraud and phishing warning If you are reading this away from the WeVote site, please apply directly via our volunteering portal/ATS at . Do not apply via any other job portals, aggregators, or sites, as your information may not be secure, or the role may no longer be accepting applications. Thank you.
Join the Movement
WeVote ’s partner VoteUSA has an open volunteering position for a Communications Manager (~5 hours per week) who wants to use their existing skills, grow new ones, and help strengthen American democracy.
About VoteUSA
Vote-USA.org informs and educates voters by producing comprehensive, nonpartisan election information for national, state, and many local elections. Founded in 2003 by Ron Kahlow, VoteUSA has researched 20,000+ candidates and 500+ issues , helping voters understand who and what they are voting for. The organization continues to close the voter‑information gap through accessible, factual election data.
About WeVote

A longtime partner of VoteUSA, WeVote is a nonpartisan, volunteer-powered civic‑tech nonprofit and a Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee. With 150+ active volunteers , WeVote builds open‑source mobile tools that help voters make informed decisions in about eight minutes - including downloading the WeVote Ballot Guide app. Learn more at or @ WeVote . We are a 100% remote organization.
What You’ll Do
As Communications Manager, you will lead VoteUSA’s communications operations, manage a small team, and oversee nationwide outreach campaigns.

• Team Leadership - Manage VoteUSA’s Communications Team and coordinate with WeVote leadership.

• Email Campaign Oversight - Oversee regular email campaigns to candidates, election officials, and voters (candidate outreach, election official verification, voter education/GOTV, volunteer communications).

• Communications Calendar - Develop a communications calendar and metrics to assess campaign effectiveness (engagement, response rates, etc.).

• Workflow Improvement - Build communication processes, improve workflows, and document best practices for consistency and efficiency.

• Agile Team Management - Run weekly agile meetings, mentor volunteers, and onboard new team members.

• Cross‑Team Collaboration - Work with Political Data and Business Development teams to ensure outreach is based on accurate election information.

• Task Assignment - Match volunteers with tasks suited to their skill levels; review work products and propose efficiency improvements.

• OKR Management - Support and track team OKRs, train volunteers unfamiliar with OKRs, follow up on deadlines, adjust schedules, and communicate changes.

• Reporting - Provide brief reports in meetings, via email, and in team newsletters on project status.

• Documentation - Keep communication documentation accurate and current.

Who You Are: Must‑Haves

• Weekly Availability - Able to volunteer at least 3-4 hours per week during WeVote ’s core hours (M-F, 9 a.m.-6 p.m. PT).

• Commitment to Democracy - You want to work with an established, successful team and are committed to strengthening American democracy.

• Personal Excellence - You strive for high‑quality work and continuous improvement.

• Collaboration - Willingness to work with and support other volunteers.

• U.S. Location - Must be located in the U.S. with 1-2 hours per week overlapping with Pacific Time.

Nice to Have (Not Required)

• Additional Volunteering - If you have more than 5 hours per week, opportunities exist to contribute more broadly within WeVote .

• Communications Background - Experience in communications, PR, nonprofit outreach, marketing, journalism, or strong written communication skills.

What You’ll Gain
You will help shape nationwide voter‑information outreach and contribute to a movement that will receive national attention. You’ll gain experience leading a remote communications team,

title: Senior CRO Strategist (Contractor)
description:
Meet Domaine , the world's largest independent Shopify design and development partner, formed by the union of Half Helix and Tomorrow. We are a team of commerce experts dedicated to creating, building, and growing beloved brands. As pioneers and not just participants in our industry, we are inspired to write, break, and re-write the rules for a new generation of commerce.

We’re looking for a thoughtful, analytical Sr eCommerce Strategist with a strong Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and UX optimization mindset to join our Strategy team. This individual contributor role is focused on uncovering insights through data, developing clear hypotheses, and partnering cross-functionally to design, test, and optimize high-impact commerce experiences within the Shopify ecosystem.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in experimentation, enjoys translating insights into action, and wants to grow alongside senior strategists while collaborating closely with UX, Design, and Engineering.

This is a contract role with a minimum commitment of 20-30 hours per week to start, with the opportunity to scale hours based on business and client needs.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead CRO and experimentation engagements for DTC e-commerce brands.

• Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to identify conversion opportunities and customer friction across the funnel.

• Develop data-backed hypotheses and build prioritized experimentation roadmaps based on potential impact and effort.

• Plan, execute, and analyze A/B tests, translating results into actionable recommendations and future test opportunities.

• Conduct CRO research including funnel analysis, UX and heuristic reviews, user testing, customer surveys, session analysis, and competitive audits.

• Partner closely with UX, Design, Engineering, and Analytics teams to bring experiments and optimization initiatives to life.

• Synthesize insights and experiment results into clear, compelling client recommendations and optimization strategies.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• Strong experience in CRO, experimentation, and e-commerce optimization, ideally within DTC.

• Hands-on experience developing hypotheses, experimentation roadmaps, and A/B tests.

• Strong e-commerce analytics skills and ability to translate data into prioritized actions.

• Strong understanding of e-commerce UX and conversion best practices.

• Experience with experimentation platforms such as VWO, Optimizely, Shoplift, Intelligems, or similar.

• Proficient with Google Analytics (GA4).

• Experience partnering with UX, Design, Engineering, and Analytics teams.

• Strong client communication and presentation skills.

• Shopify experience required.

• BigQuery, SQL, and/or advanced analytics experience is a plus.

PERKS & BENEFITS

• Flexible working schedule

• Remote-first culture

• Continued education and personal development opportunities

We are an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: AI Growth Marketer — DTC Channel
description:

title: Bilingual Virtual Medical Assistant - With Scribe Experience
description:
Location: Remote (Candidates from Latin America / South America - Fixed Location Required )
Position Type: Part-time to Full-time (Starting at 30 hours/week)
I. Role Overview
We are seeking a highly dedicated and detail-oriented Virtual Medical Scribe and Assistant to support a fast-paced Gastroenterology practice in the United States. This role is critical in ensuring clinical excellence by providing real-time scribing, comprehensive pre-charting, and essential administrative support.
The ideal candidate will be a licensed nurse with a strong clinical background and a stable, high-performance home office setup.
II. About the Clinic and Physician

• Specialization: Gastroenterology.

• Physician Profile: Our specialist is highly demanding and operates on a word-of-mouth referral basis. His time is split equally between the surgery center and clinical patient care.

• Culture: Fast-moving and professional. The practice relies solely on its reputation for excellence.

III. Key Responsibilities & Tasks

• Pre-Charting: Reviewing patient schedules in advance to prepare charts; pulling lab results, imaging reports, and prior consultation notes into the EMR so the physician is prepared before each visit.

• Real-Time Medical Scribing: Accompanying the doctor virtually during patient visits to record clinical notes and documentation accurately.

• Patient Coordination: Handling incoming calls and scheduling appointments during non-scribing hours.

• Clinical Communication: Relaying information between the physician and patients.

• Workflow Integration: Assisting the doctor between back-to-back appointments to maintain a smooth clinic flow.

IV. Mandatory Requirements
Clinical & Educational Background

• Nursing Background: A Bachelor's degree in Nursing (RN/BSN) is required to ensure a deep understanding of medical terminology, pharmacology, and drug interactions.

• Experience: At least one year of experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant or Scribe.

• Educational Recency: Candidates should ideally be within five years of graduation or active practice to ensure up-to-date knowledge.

• Language Proficiency: Must be Bilingual (English and Spanish) .

Technical & Security Specifications

• Fixed Working Location: The candidate must work from one specific, consistent location only . Epic EMR access is tied to a verified IP address; changing locations or IP addresses causes significant security disruptions and requires hours of technical modification to restore access.

• Hardware: Minimum 8 GB RAM .

• Monitor: Minimum 21-22 inch monitor . Epic does not function well on smaller screens without 32 GB RAM.

• Multitasking: Ability to run Epic and Zoom simultaneously on the same computer (no phone/tablet workarounds).

Compliance

• Documentation: Must provide a valid Passport, Criminal Background Check and Professional License.

V. Nice to Haves

• Software Proficiency: Prior experience with Epic EMR is a significant advantage.

• Specialty Exposure: Previous experience in Gastroenterology or surgical practices.

VI. Schedule and Training

• Training Period: Two-week intensive phase (Epic EMR and practice-specific workflows).

• Working Hours: Starts at 30 hours per week , with the potential to move to 40 hours based on performance.

Are you excited about the opportunity to work on the top tier edge of technology with both visibility and impact to the success of a leader like NVIDIA ? If so, the Solution Architecture Team invites you to consider this opportunity.

NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, revolutionized parallel computing, and ignited modern AI - the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can tackle, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work, to amplify human imagination and intelligence; join our team today!

What you will be doing:

• In this role, you will research and develop techniques to GPU-accelerate high performance database, ETL and data analytics applications.

• Work directly with other technical experts in their fields (industry and academia) to perform in-depth analysis and optimization of complex data intensive workloads to ensure the best possible performance of current GPU architectures.

• Influence the design of next-generation hardware architectures, software, and programming models in collaboration with research, hardware, system software, libraries, and tools teams at NVIDIA

• Influence partners (industry and academia) to push the bounds of data processing with NVIDIA ’s full product line

What we need to see:

• Masters or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related computationally focused science degree or equivalent experience.

• 8+ years of experience.

• Programming fluency in C/C++ with a deep understanding of algorithms and software design.

• Hands-on experience with low-level parallel programming, e.g. CUDA (preferred), OpenACC, OpenMP, MPI, pthreads, TBB, etc.

• In-depth expertise with CPU/GPU architecture fundamentals, especially memory subsystem.

• Domain expertise in high performance databases, ETL, data analytics and/or vector database.

• Good communication and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, and prioritization skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Experience optimizing/implementing database operators or query planner, especially for parallel or distributed frameworks (e.g. production database or Spark).

• Background with optimizing vector database index build and/or search.

title: Mobile Application Business Analyst (Employed or freelance)
description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités
Vous rejoignez une équipe en charge de l’analyse, de la préparation et de l’exécution de projets digitaux. Dans le cadre de la refonte complète d’une application mobile, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la traduction des besoins métier en éléments fonctionnels clairs, cohérents et exploitables par les équipes UX/UI et de développement.
Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du cycle de définition fonctionnelle jusqu’à la préparation du développement, avec une attention particulière portée à la cohérence entre parcours utilisateurs, écrans, backlog et critères d’acceptation.
Description de mission
Le rôle consiste à faire le lien entre :

• les besoins métier,

• l’expérience utilisateur (UX),

• les équipes design,

• les équipes de développement,

• l’architecture,

• la QA et la gestion de projet.

Vous êtes garant de la structuration des parcours utilisateurs, de la transformation des besoins en spécifications fonctionnelles et de la traçabilité entre les différentes étapes de conception et de delivery.
Responsabilités principales
1. Analyse métier et cadrage fonctionnel

• Recueillir les besoins métier et utilisateurs.

• Challenge les demandes afin d’en clarifier les objectifs réels.

• Structurer les User Journeys et formaliser les parcours détaillés.

• Identifier les pain points, les cas complexes et les dépendances.

• Prioriser les besoins avec les parties prenantes du projet.

2. Structuration des parcours utilisateurs

• Définir les parcours de bout en bout.

• Décomposer chaque parcours en étapes détaillées.

• Prendre en compte les variantes, exceptions, cas d’erreur, scénarios offline, dépendances temps réel et besoins d’accessibilité (PMR).

• Garantir une couverture complète des scénarios critiques et des edge cases.

3. Transformation des besoins en éléments exploitables
Vous structurez et maintenez la traçabilité complète entre :
User Journey → Features → Screens → User Stories → Acceptance Criteria

• Transformer les besoins métier en fonctionnalités détaillées.

• Réaliser le screen mapping et contribuer au screen inventory.

• Formaliser des wireflows fonctionnels clairs.

• Veiller à l’exhaustivité des écrans et à la cohérence des comportements attendus.

4. Préparation du travail UX/UI

• Préparer les éléments nécessaires au travail des designers.

• Définir le maillage des écrans et les comportements fonctionnels.

• Documenter les différents états : loading, error, empty, offline et edge cases.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les UX/UI Designers pour assurer la cohérence des parcours.

5. Gestion et structuration du backlog

• Rédiger les Epics et les User Stories.

• Définir des Acceptance Criteria précis et exploitables.

• Structurer les dépendances et préparer les refinements.

• Maintenir un backlog complexe clair, priorisé et actionnable dans un cadre Agile / Scrum.

6. Coordination avec les équipes de delivery

• Collaborer avec les équipes techniques afin de clarifier les comportements attendus.

• Participer aux ateliers UX/UI et aux refinements Agile.

• Apporter un support aux équipes QA/UAT.

• Faciliter l’alignement entre les besoins métier, la conception et l’implémentation.

7. Documentation et gouvernance fonctionnelle

• Maintenir la documentation fonctionnelle dans Confluence.

• Utiliser des outils de modélisation tels que Draw.io lorsque pertinent.

• Structurer les référentiels fonctionnels avec rigueur.

• Garantir la cohérence documentaire et la traçabilité entre besoins, parcours, écrans, stories et tests.

• Assurer une rédaction fonctionnelle de haut niveau, adaptée à des projets mobiles complexes.

Livrables attendus

• User Journeys détaillés

• Mapping fonctionnel

• Screen Inventory

• Wireflows fonctionnels

• Epics

• User Stories

• Acceptance Criteria

• Documentation Confluence

• Support aux scénarios UAT

• Matrices de traçabilité

title: Account Manager
description:
ABOUT US:

AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Our customers include category-defining companies like Lovable https://modal.com/blog/lovable-case-study, Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We recently raised a $355M Series C https://modal.com/blog/modal-series-c at a $4.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn, Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring the first Account Managers at Modal. You'll report to the Regional Director of Account Management and be a founding member of the team.

This function does not exist yet. There is no playbook, no territory map, no established motion. You'll own a book of business from day one and build the motion at the same time - from fast-moving AI startups to large enterprise teams running critical infrastructure on Modal.

This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You'll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won't be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you need to hold your own in those conversations.

The profile we're hiring is a technical account manager. You've worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can credibly work with a CxO all the way down to a Developer.

WHAT THE ROLE IS

- A founding seat. You're helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence you and the rest of the founding team figure out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you.

- A technical customer-facing role. You'll work directly with Developers and ML teams on what they're building and how Modal fits. You translate and triage the deeper technical work to FDEs and Product when it's needed.

- A book of business. You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences.

WHAT THE ROLE IS NOT

- A traditional post-sales role. You're measured on revenue, not health scores.

- An on-call support function. You're not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You're driving growth.

- A technical delivery role. You're not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people.

- An inherited motion. Nothing is handed to you. If you identify gaps in process, tooling, or a playbook - you help build it.

- A single-lane job. Our priorities go customer → company → team → me. We focus on delivering maximum impact vs. "this is my job".

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

- Build Modal's account management function and iterate on it as we scale the business

- Own and deliver on a revenue target across your book of accounts

title: Security Systems Technical Lead
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Security Systems Technical Lead to be embedded on our client’s Security Technology team.

The Technical Lead will provide expertise and direction for the design, deployment, optimization, and ongoing health of enterprise physical security technology. This role supports complex security systems initiatives, evaluates and improves existing technologies and processes, and serves as a key technical partner to security, IT, engineering, and vendor teams. The Technical Lead will oversee solutions from requirements and design through implementation and operational support, while identifying opportunities to improve system reliability, scalability, lifecycle management, and overall security program effectiveness.

This is a full-time, fully remote position offering a comprehensive benefits package.

Responsibilities

• Lead the planning, technical execution, and delivery of enterprise physical security technology projects, including PACS, VMS, video analytics, and related security infrastructure.

• Own projects from requirements gathering and technical design through testing, deployment, commissioning, and operational handoff.

• Develop project plans, schedules, milestones, and technical requirements while managing dependencies, risks, and resource needs.

• Evaluate existing security systems and develop remediation strategies to improve system health, reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness.

• Provide technical leadership for system migrations, upgrades, integrations, and lifecycle initiatives across on-premises, hybrid, and SaaS environments.

• Perform or oversee system configuration, provisioning, integration testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution across enterprise security platforms.

• Review technical designs, system architectures, device configurations, and infrastructure requirements to ensure solutions meet security, operational, and enterprise standards.

• Partner with security operations, IT, engineering, vendors, and other stakeholders to align technical solutions with business and operational requirements.

• Identify opportunities to improve security technology processes, system lifecycle management, and operational workflows through standardization and automation.

• Develop technical documentation, SOPs, implementation plans, and recommendations that support sustainable system operations and continuous improvement.

Required

title: Langfuse - Senior Product Engineer
description:
WHY PRODUCT ENGINEERING AT LANGFUSE

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. Langfuse has 21,900+ GitHub stars and our SDKs are downloaded 23M+ times per month. When you ship a new feature the community notices in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community channels.

Product engineers at Langfuse are the people who deliver new features end-to-end to our users. You own the product thinking from understanding the user problem to deciding what to build to shipping the solution.

You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers leveraging Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible product and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

 

YOU WILL GROW AT LANGFUSE BY

- Own features end-to-end: from talking to users, to writing the spec, to shipping the code and docs, to writing the changelog post https://langfuse.com/changelog with your name on it. To give you a sense: recent features a single engineer owned include the Langfuse for Agents https://langfuse.com/changelog/2025-11-05-langfuse-for-agents release (new trace views, agent graphs, semantic span labels), the TypeScript SDK v4 https://langfuse.com/changelog/2025-08-28-typescript-sdk-v4-ga rewrite on OpenTelemetry, and the hosted MCP server https://langfuse.com/changelog/2025-11-20-hosted-mcp-server for prompt management.

- Work across the full stack: and we mean full. Our surface area is wide: React frontend, Next.js backend, ClickHouse analytics, Python and TypeScript SDKs, public docs, Terraform modules, and more. You'll touch whatever the feature needs. One week you might be writing a new ClickHouse query for cost analytics, the next you're designing an SDK API, the next you're building a new React view for agent traces.

- Talk to users constantly: jump on calls, respond in community channels, and route support requests. At Langfuse, support is how we build conviction about what to build next. Our handbook says it best: support by engineers is a core value proposition.

- Write public documentation about the features you own. At Langfuse, docs are product.

- Ship publicly during Launch Weeks: we've run four Launch Weeks https://langfuse.com/blog/2025-10-29-launch-week-4 so far, dropping a new feature every day for a week. Engineers present the features they built to the community.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Someone who has built features or even entire products from scratch end-to-end

- Experience building and shipping user-facing products end-to-end, ideally in TypeScript/React and with exposure to data-intensive backends

- Someone who can manage projects themselves. You know how to develop strong conviction about what to build and how to ship it.

- Taste for great developer experience: you care about API design, UI details, and clear documentation

- Interest in open source software and genuine excitement about talking to developers about their problems

- Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

- CS or quantitative degree preferred

Bonus points:

- Experience with ClickHouse, analytics databases, or building complex data visualizations

- Former founder or early startup experience

- Contributions to popular open source projects

- ML/AI background or familiarity with the LLM framework ecosystem

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply.

 

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

- Time off - Flexible time off i

title: Project Manager
description:
About Us

We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact. As the parent company, Agital supports three specialized agencies: Go Fish Digital , REQ, and WDG, with shared infrastructure, advanced technology, and deeply experienced people, allowing each brand to do its best work.

Go Fish Digital is an engineering-forward performance marketing agency specializing in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), its Barracuda AI platform, social commerce, and conversion-focused creative.

WDG designs and builds complex enterprise web experiences for associations, nonprofits, foundations, universities, and other mission-driven organizations.

REQ is a digital marketing and communications agency specializing in brand, reputation, and advocacy for global organizations across technology, healthcare, finance, hospitality, and real estate.

Together, we operate as one collaborative ecosystem, combining deep expertise, AI-powered capabilities, and a culture of curiosity to help ambitious brands grow while creating meaningful opportunities for our people.

About the Role

Go Fish Digital is where digital marketing meets clarity, creativity, and scale. As our agency grows and our client engagements become increasingly complex and cross-functional, strong project management is essential to ensuring great strategy turns into great execution.

The Project Manager serves as the operational backbone of assigned client work. This person creates the structure that allows Client Strategy and delivery teams to execute effectively, turning priorities and decisions into clear tasks, realistic timelines, coordinated resources, and measurable progress.

You will work across teams to keep complex client work moving, identify risks before they become problems, and create the visibility teams need to deliver on time and profitably.

What You'll Do

You will own the execution system for a portfolio of complex client accounts and projects.

You will partner closely with Client Strategy and delivery teams to translate approved strategy into actionable work, coordinate timelines and dependencies, maintain clear project plans, and ensure teams have the information and capacity needed to deliver.

You will not own the client relationship or service strategy. Instead, you will create operational discipline around those functions, making sure decisions turn into action, risks surface early, and commitments remain realistic.

Your involvement will vary based on the complexity of the account or project. On some engagements, you may be deeply embedded in internal planning and execution; on others, you may provide lighter project governance and periodic oversight. Go Fish intentionally uses a tiered PM model based on account complexity, revenue impact, coordination burden, timeline risk, capacity needs, and margin exposure.

Key Functions

Project Planning and Execution

• Translate approved strategy and project decisions into clear work plans, tasks, milestones, dependencies, owners, and timelines.

• Build and maintain realistic project schedules that reflect scope, priorities, team capacity, and delivery dependencies.

• Monitor execution, adjust plans as conditions change, and ensure decisions consistently move into action.

• Ensure assigned work meets Go Fish standards for task clarity, ownership, dates, estimates, prioritization, and actionable context.

Cross-Functional Coordination

• Coordinate work across Client Strategy, delivery teams, and other contributors to keep multi-service and project-based engagements moving smoothly.

• Translate internal decisions into clear next steps and ensure owners understand dependencies, priorities, and expectations.

• Identify handoff gaps, conflicting priorities, and unclear ownership before they disrupt delivery.

title: AWS DevOps Engineer (Associate)
description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores ' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60-70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
This role sits in our Application & Database Modernization pillar: moving legacy applications, databases, and infrastructure from on-premises to cloud-native AWS on committed dates. Customers come to us with dedicated hardware that costs more every year, deployments that depend on one person's memory, and enterprise workloads- Linux, Windows, big data that nobody wants to touch.
You'll join the DevOps team that lands these migrations. Aedeon handles the discovery and dependency-mapping grind; you build the automation, monitoring, and CI infrastructure that makes each cutover repeatable and safe. This is a client-facing engineering role: you'll set customer expectations, meet them, and see your infrastructure work carry production traffic.
What you will do?

• Deliver application migration projects from on-premises to AWS.

• Deliver database migration projects RDBMS, NoSQL, DW, Hadoop from on-premises to AWS.

• Automate operational and server provisioning workflows using AWS CFT on AWS.

• Share responsibility for deploying releases and running operations maintenance.

• Improve operations infrastructure: Jenkins clusters, Bitbucket, monitoring tools (Consul), and metrics tools such as Graphite and Grafana.

• Provide operational support for the rest of the engineering team.

title: Software Engineer (Mid-Level)
description:
​
Job Description - Software Engineer (Mid-Level)
Reports To - Engineering Manager
Summary
AxisCare is hiring a full-time, fully remote mid-level Software Engineer to join a team that's actively rethinking how software gets made.
Does this sound familiar? You're a skilled developer, and you can see where things are heading. The engineers who are just coders - the ones whose value came from being the person who could translate a spec into working code - are the ones AI is going to eat up first. You don't want that to be you. You want to get ahead of this by going deep on the things that still matter: system architecture, software design, and a real understanding of the problems you're solving. This is a senior-track position, and you'll find a team of senior and staff engineers deeply invested in your growth.
We're no longer building the car by hand, so to speak. We're building the factory that makes great cars, with humans in the loop where the human touch matters most. We want engineers who are genuinely energized by that shift and want to help figure out what it means in practice. (Read more about how we think AI is changing product development.)
You'll join an autonomous project team working on our market-leading home care SaaS, built on a PHP web stack with a React/TypeScript frontend. You'll ship real features for real agencies whose operations depend on our software.
There will always be a need for people who deeply understand our customers' most important problems, solve them with high-quality software, and run that software reliably in production. That's the work that endures, and that's the work we're hiring for.
No egos here. Just a handful of humble, talented, and conscientious builders who play well with others and work as a team to ship great things.
What This Role Actually Looks Like
You'll be building well-scoped features with oversight and mentorship from senior and staff engineers who are deep in this work. But a mid-level engineer is something very different in 2026 than it was two years ago. Concretely, we expect you to:

• Use AI as a core part of how you build. Not as a novelty or a copilot for autocomplete, but as a primary tool for prototyping, exploring, refactoring, writing tests, and shipping. We want to hear about the workflows you've developed, where agents work well for you, and just as importantly where they break down.

• Push the tools until they fail, then tell us about it. We're actively mapping the frontier. An engineer who tries something ambitious with AI, hits a wall, and writes up what they learned is more valuable to us than one who sticks to what's comfortable.

• Care about the problem, not just the code. Since writing code is no longer the scarce resource, understanding what we should build and why it matters to home care agencies matters more than ever. The engineers who thrive here get curious about customers and operations, not just tickets.

• Ship quality software that's easy to change. High-quality software is valuable now and easy to change later. Moving fast with AI only works if the work holds up.

• Manage your time to ship on time. Make meaningful progress on what matters and avoid getting lost in unimportant details. This is more important than ever when AI makes it easy to chase rabbit holes.

• Share what you're learning. This is a team sport, and the team only gets better if wins and lessons travel.

• Write well. Good writing matters here. Remote work demands it, clear writing is clear thinking, and clear thinking is how you get the biggest impact from AI.

What We're Looking For

• At least 2 years of professional experience on teams building web apps with the full PHP stack, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

• Experience building React apps in TypeScript

• Working knowledge of object-oriented programming and relational databases (MySQL or similar)

• Comfort with Git and collaborative development

• Demonstrated, substantive use of AI coding tools in real project

description:
Backend Solutions Architect - Remote

Job Title : Backend Solutions Architect

Position Type : Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range : $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required : 6+ years

Sponsorship:  U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in distributed systems to design, build, and operate large-scale, high-throughput backend services that power mission-critical workloads. In this role you will architect the core platforms that other engineering teams build on, focusing on scalability, reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices. The ideal candidate will combine strong fundamentals in computer science with practical, battle-tested experience operating distributed systems at scale, and will be comfortable navigating the trade-offs between consistency, availability, and latency.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and implement large-scale distributed backend systems using Java, Go, Scala, or similar high-performance languages.

• Architect data partitioning, replication, and consistency strategies appropriate to each workload’s requirements.

• Build resilient APIs and event-driven services with strong observability, idempotency, and graceful degradation patterns.

• Optimize systems for latency, throughput, and cost, using profiling, benchmarking, and load testing.

• Lead detailed architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and trade-off analyses.

• Implement robust failure-handling patterns including retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, bulkheads, and saga workflows.

• Design and operate data stores at scale, including relational, key-value, document, and search engines.

• Build comprehensive observability into services with structured logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.

• Drive incident response and post-incident learning for critical backend services.

• Mentor mid-level engineers and lead by example in code quality, design, and operational rigor.

• Partner with SRE and platform teams to drive reliability improvements and reduce operational toil.

• Contribute to long-term architecture and platform strategy, helping shape multi-year technical roadmaps and ensuring near-term execution remains aligned with the broader engineering direction.

• Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation - including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures - so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.

• Six or more years of professional backend engineering experience, with significant time on distributed systems.

Job Title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - Portsmouth
Job Location: Work at Home, Ohio, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Per diem employees qualify for:

• Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)
